conviction_note: Q3 is largely pre-released through Bullish's own monthly metrics (Q3 volume $121.8B vs $131B in Q2, spreads flat) and the Q3 SS&O level is implied by the company's own 45/55 H2 split, so the print turns on the Q4/FY guide into a ~25% BTC drawdown and a -22% MoM October volume; that leans mildly negative, but the stock is already -33% in 20 days at a 52-week low with call-heavy OI and a modest short, so p_up 46 on an 11% scale (-0.88) while the findings sum to -0.4; the two agree in sign and are both small because the evidence mostly offsets.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus adjusted revenue ~$84.8M and EPS ~$0.10 (Chartmill estimates page, via search snippet: https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/BLSH/estimates); Earnings Whispers EPS consensus $0.08 (https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/BLSH). findings.finding: Q3 2026 trading volume is already public from Bullish's own monthly metrics: July $30.7B, August $42.5B, September $48.6B = $121.8B total, vs ~$131B in Q2 2026 (-7% QoQ), with average spreads of 2.62/2.13/2.14 bps vs 2.23-2.56 bps in Q2; volume x spread implies adjusted transaction revenue of roughly $27-28M vs $29.9M in Q2 (my inference, not a company number).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (2026-05-14): transaction revenue -9.5% YoY to $38.0M and revenue below consensus, stock ~-8% premarket (https://parameter.io/bullish-blsh-shares-plunge-8-as-first-quarter-results-miss-expectations/). Q3 2025 print: fell ~8% on core trading revenue slide despite a record quarter (https://www.theblock.co/post/379520/bullish-stock-falls-after-posting-18-5-million-profit-in-q3-earnings).
findings.why_not_priced: It largely is: the volumes and spreads are company-published and any model can multiply them. What is not visible is how the sell-side revenue consensus split transaction vs SS&O; if consensus carries ~$31-32M transaction revenue, a ~$3-4M miss on that line is not in the price. Sized near zero because the line is pre-released.
findings.independence: Coinbase's Q3 2026 spot volume fell ~8% QoQ to ~$135B and transaction revenue was down 1% QoQ (https://theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-30-coinbase-q3-net-income-jumps-432189); Q2 volume $131B from https://quartr.com/events/bullish-blsh-q2-2026_FVbtDeFg and June metrics (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/bullish-reports-june-2026-trading-volume-of-50-9b/44968422).

findings.finding: The company's own H2 split (CFO on the Q2 call: H2 SS&O ~45% in Q3, 55% in Q4) applied to the FY2026 SS&O guide of $225-245M and H1 SS&O of ~$117.5M implies Q3 SS&O of ~$48-57M, a sequential DECLINE from the record $62.7M in Q2; added to ~$27-28M transaction revenue that is total adjusted revenue of ~$76-85M against a ~$84.8M consensus, i.e. a modest revenue miss risk that sits inside what the company guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-13): record SS&O $62.7M, revenue beat ($92.6M vs ~$88.0M) and a raised low end of the FY SS&O range, stock +10-13% intraday, then -11% the next day on an SEC tokenization delay (https://www.tikr.com/blog/bullish-stock-gained-12-lost-11-the-next-day-the-tokenization-bet-just-got-slower). SS&O is the line this stock has paid for.
findings.why_not_priced: Inside guidance, so mostly priced; the open question is whether consensus followed the 45/55 split or the 'sequential growth expected in Q3 and Q4' phrasing in the Quartr summary (https://quartr.com/events/bullish-blsh-q2-2026_FVbtDeFg), which would require Q3 SS&O above $62.7M. If the street modelled growth, revenue misses; the ~$84.8M consensus (below Q2's $92.6M) suggests most of the street already modelled a decline. Revenue bar single-sourced, so capped small.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 adj. revenue $92.8M and transaction $38.0M from the company release (https://www.bullish.com/news-insights/bullish-reports-first-quarter-2026-results); FY guide from the Q2 release (https://www.bullish.com/news-insights/bullish-reports-second-quarter-2026-results). Shares the bar with finding 1.

findings.finding: Q4-to-date has turned down hard after Bullish last guided: October 2026 total volume $37.7B (-22.4% MoM, -53% YoY) per the company's own metrics released 2026-11-05, and BTC fell from roughly $84-86K at the 30 Sep quarter end to a four-month low near $62K on 2026-11-15 with ~$1.9B of ETF outflows; the FY SS&O guide needs Q4 SS&O of ~$59-70M, and price-linked SS&O pieces (CoinDesk index/ETP benchmark fees, liquidity services, lending) shrink with prices, so a trimmed or held-at-low-end FY guide on the call is the main negative risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Raised FY SS&O low end on 2026-08-13 coincided with a +10-13% day; Q1 2026's reaffirmed guide with a revenue miss traded ~-8%. No prior instance of a cut to compare.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -33% in 20 days and -13% in 5, which is the crypto drawdown itself. What is not visible is management's translation into the FY SS&O range; if the market expected a cut, the skew would be strongly put-bid and OI put-heavy, and instead skew is +1.93 and put/call OI 0.27. Transmission from BTC price to SS&O is my inference (proxy), so sized moderately.
findings.independence: BTC four-month low ~$62K, Nov 15 2026 (https://cointelegraph.com/news/bitcoin-four-month-low-62k-crypto-market-selloff); BTC +~43% in Q3 to ~$84-86K at quarter end (https://cryptobriefing.com/bitcoin-q3-up-44-best-quarter/); Bitcoin breaks below $72K, 2026-11-12 (https://coinalertnews.com/news/2026/11/12/bitcoin-crashes-below-72k).

findings.finding: The largest US crypto exchange peer sold off on its Q3 2026 print: Coinbase (reported 2026-10-29) fell ~5% after hours as core trading stayed weak (transaction revenue -1% QoQ, total revenue $1.216B slightly below a ~$1.233B bar), while Galaxy (2026-10-27) opened ~6% higher on AI/data-centre EBITDA, which Bullish does not have.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: Bullish fell ~8% on a core-trading slide despite a record quarter, the same pattern the Coinbase reaction shows this season.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer print is three weeks old and public, so mostly priced; it is filed as a read on how this season's crypto-exchange prints are being received (core trading sold), not as new information. Peer, not counterparty: small.
findings.independence: Galaxy +6% open on Q3 2026 (https://blockspace.media/insight/galaxy-helios-reports-quarterly-ebitda/); Coinbase Q3 volumes (https://theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-30-coinbase-q3-net-income-jumps-432189).

findings.finding: BTC rose ~43% in Q3 2026 and Bullish holds a ~23-24K BTC treasury (Q2 net loss of $(280.0)M included a ~$244.6M BTC markdown), so Q3 IFRS net income should swing sharply positive from the Q2 loss via remeasurement or impairment reversal; a headline profit print is a below-the-line one-off the adjusted metrics exclude.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: a $280M headline net loss did not stop a +10-13% day (https://cryptobriefing.com/bullish-stock-surges-despite-280m-loss/); Q3 2025: an $18.5M headline profit came with an ~8% fall. The headline net line has not driven this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Arithmetically predictable for anyone who tracks the treasury, and excluded from adjusted EPS; it matters only to headline-reading flow in the pre-market. If it were priced as operating value it would have shown up in the stock during the Q3 BTC rally rather than the stock falling from $34.89 at 9/30.
findings.independence: Q3 BTC +~43% (https://cointelegraph.com/news/bitcoin-etf-6-3-billion-inflows-q3-btc-rise-43); holdings ~24,300 BTC per The Block (https://theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-13-peter-thiel-backed-bullish-posts-280-million-q2-net-loss-as-digital-asset-sales-fall-44-411695).

findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is by definition in the price; what it changes is the asymmetry of the reaction to a non-disaster guide. If the market were braced for a guide cut, the put/call OI would not be 0.27.
